packages.title: two new defects and the confirmed verifier findings of packages 1 to 6
packages.brief: Read reports/E13-campaign/repairs-brief.md in full. It lists two defects (D1, D2) and 18 repairs (R1 to R18); each was confirmed against the tree at version 1.1.12. Apply every entry. The six packages before this one are in the tree: read `git diff HEAD --stat -- src tests` first. In `notes` report one line per entry D1, D2 and R1 to R18: done or not done, and the test or the lines that changed. Add D1, D2 and R16 to the `## [Unreleased]` section of CHANGELOG.md, and correct a sentence in README.md, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/api-reference.md or .claude/skills/docdistance/SKILL.md only where D1, D2, R15 or R16 makes it false. The item ACC-TRANS-83 is met by R3 together with the existing test of the tie-break; ACC-TRANS-71 is rejected as overridden by it.
packages.verify_note: the brief of this package is reports/E13-campaign/repairs-brief.md. Check every entry D1, D2 and R1 to R18 against the tree: applied as written, or reported as not applied with a reason that holds. Run the reproduction of D1 yourself and the two checks D2 names. An entry applied beyond what it says is a finding.
